reason: 'Crested' means one crest. 'Double-crested' means two, and the rule loses that.
Introrse (opening towards the flower centre) fits anthers and stamens. 'Inward-facing' on other parts is not introrse.
Pocket-like means pouched, which is saccate.
'Slightly developed' is about degree of development, not size. It could be reduced or rudimentary, so reject.
A button is a flat round disc, so discoid fits.
Diclinous means unisexual flowers: stamens and pistils in separate flowers.
Hair-fringed means margin with cilia.
Subfimbriate means somewhat fimbriate, the same pattern as other sub- terms.
Glochidate means bearing barbed bristles (glochids), so barbed is close.
Half-globose means hemispherical.
Subvillous means slightly villous, the same pattern as other sub- terms.
Atrocastaneous means very dark chestnut-brown. Plain red brown loses the dark shade.
Embedded and sunken are not the same. Negating one does not give the negation of the other.
Set with scales means scaly.
Unequilateral means with unequal sides, which is asymmetrical, as in leaf bases.
Carrion-smelling is a foul odour, so foetid.
Without endosperm means endosperm absent.
Bronze-tinged states a bronze colour, with only a weaker intensity.
Lunate means crescent-shaped. 'Obliquely' only adds orientation.
Semi-subterranean means only partly underground. 'Subterranean' loses the partial meaning.
An unpleasant smell is foetid.
A lambda is an asymmetric Y-like figure with legs of unequal length. It is not a symmetric V.
'Keel' is a noun for a part (keel or carina), not the quality keel-shaped. As a quality word it would mislabel parts.
Lyrato-pinnately lobed means lyrate-pinnatifid, which is lyrate.
Perfumed means pleasantly scented.
Pock-marked means pitted, which is foveate.
Sausage-like means a thick cylinder with rounded ends, so cylindrical.
Semicoriaceous means somewhat leathery, which is subcoriaceous.
Unpleasantly smelling is foetid.
Enrolled means rolled up. That is not curled, which is a bend or curl.
Sacking-like means coarse and woven like sacking cloth. It is not simply fibrous. Reject.
Scarcely evident means barely visible, which is inconspicuous.
Patent means spreading, so semi-patent means half-spreading. It does not mean semi erect.
Stelliform means star-shaped.
Not emergent means not projecting beyond the enclosing structure, which is included.
Bractiferous means bract-bearing, so bract present.
Only a spelling variant of palmately lobed.
Anvil-shaped matches the PATO anvil shape.
Ball-like means spherical.
Balsamic describes an aromatic smell of balsam, which is not the resinous texture or property. Reject.
Basally attached means basifixed.
The rule loses 'basally'. The quality is a base that is expanded, not the whole part dilated.
The rule loses 'basally'. Only the base is inflated, not the whole part.
Bottlebrush-like is a brush-like shape.
Bulbil-bearing means bulbils are present.
Carpeting growth is mat-forming.
Close set means placed close together, which is approximate.
Clove scent is a spicy scent.
The rule loses 'compound'. This is a compound inflorescence, corymb-like in form, not a simple corymb.
Densely clustered means aggregated. The density is only an intensity.
